notes.title: July Maintenance Update
notes.content: [p]Hey everybody,[/p][p][/p][p]Following the release of [url="https://twistedmetal.remdigitalstudios.com/"]the DLC[/url] a couple days ago, I've got a lot of helpful feedback. I'd like to extend a huge thanks to [url="https://www.youtube.com/@inSAMity"]inSAMity[/url] for a very detailed list of bugs and suggestions. I've fixed a lot of issues within the DLC files, so an update will be required when updating to this new Smash N' Crash version.[/p][p][/p][p]-- NullReferenceException[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h3][b]Update Notes (v05-2025-07-15)[/b][/h3][p][/p][p][url="https://docs.remdigi.com/en/games/smash-n-crash/dlc/tm4r/changelogs/changelog-v02-2025-07-15"]DLC changelog (v02-2025-07-15)[/url][/p][p][/p][p][b]Vehicles:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Added in-air physics control when < 2 wheels are on the ground[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed texture mapping on plane[/p][/*][*][p]Added upper door and adjusted lower door of plane cargo bay[/p][/*][*][p]Added "Press ↑↑↓↓ to Teleport" prompt when vehicle is stuck[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed parachutes in multiplayer being controlled by other players[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed grille guard for F150 and RAM. Removed grille with bumper guard for those vehicles[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed camera shake bug on vehicle collision[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted AI vehicle controller properties and pathfinding[/p][/*][*][p]Added pathfinder functionality for AI vehicles on applicable levels[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed AI vehicles still driving and shooting when freezing[/p][/*][*][p]Lowered police count during heat to prevent overpopulation[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]Weapons:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Added mouse forward/backwards as fire secondary buttons[/p][/*][*][p]Added weapon fire direction control (forward/backward)[/p][/*][*][p]Added fire direction toggle for controller (right stick press)[/p][/*][*][p]Added fire rear button for keyboard (middle mouse / hold \[Q])[/p][/*][*][p]Increased proximity mine range and damage[/p][/*][*][p]Reworked weapon collision system using a SphereCast sweep -- collisions are much more accurate and consistent, with less missed hits.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed weapons colliding with pickups[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed remote-detonated missiles not removing from inventory if destroyed by collision[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Napalm exploding mid-air[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed AudioSources for some weapons not stopping on destroy[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed MIRV and Incendiary MIRV not tracking targets properly[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Rain and Rain 2 colliding with itself (wrong layers)[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed lightning not targeting or damaging vehicles[/p][/*][*][p]Added layer check for pickups to prevent spawning inside objects[/p][/*][*][p]Added AI weapon fix for still shooting while frozen[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]UI:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Added dynamic controls prompts list for main controls and combos in pause menu[/p][/*][*][p]Added icons for mouse controls (for keyboard + mouse)[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed splitscreen mode button showing with more than 2 screens but having no functionality -- splitscreen mode changes only supported for 2 players (vertical/horizontal)[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed splitscreen blank corner artifacts in 3 and 5 player mode[/p][/*][*][p]Added enemy health bars system above minimap[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed fullscreen toggle not working[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed multiplayer death UI message showing in singleplayer[/p][/*][*][p]Added localization to button combos[/p][/*][*][p]Added localization for all weapons[/p][/*][*][p]Added package compatibility warning system to package loader (during intro), and main menu[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed UI scaling[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]Missions:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Removed Terminal Velocity from story mode and made Buy The Farm the first mission until the lore deepens[/p][/*][*][p]Added (temporary) ending to story mode, with an 'escape from the airport' mission[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed story mode not progressing properly to the next mission[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed bug with freeroam not starting after story mode is completed[/p][/*][/list][p][/p]
